opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers from the humanities and social sciences based at a UK university or research organisation; British citizens or EEA nationals; must have completed doctorate between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027; must not hold a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships supporting early‑career researchers to undertake independent research leading to a publishable piece.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers holding a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or Independent Research Organisation; eligible in humanities or social sciences; must be ordinarily resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Supports UK researchers to develop specialist skills and capacities through up to 12‑month projects, with awards up to £10,000.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators in the humanities or social sciences holding an established role; must involve international partners and genuine interdisciplinary collaboration across SHAPE and STEM disciplines.
opportunities.summary: Funding for interdisciplinary projects on mobilities, led by UK researchers with international collaborators, for up to two years.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences; must be based at a UK university or research institute; fellowship hosted at DGAP in Berlin.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships to develop skills, networks and produce policy‑relevant analysis for German decision‑makers.

opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a permanent or fixed‑term position at a UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation; must propose genuine interdisciplinary collaboration across the Academies.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for established researchers to pursue interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven research that benefits wider society.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any UK‑based researcher across all career stages; projects must involve a partnership with a GLAM or performing‑arts organisation.
opportunities.summary: Funding for public‑engagement projects that connect humanities and social sciences research with wider audiences.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: Up to £4,000 (higher amounts possible in exceptional cases)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs of award‑holders or applicants, such as equipment, caring costs, or accessibility support.
